atoms.text: Go straight until you see the library on your right.
From the library, head north on Silver Street.
When you see the supermarket on your left, turn left.
Turn left again around the corner to reach the entrance of the supermarket.

atoms.text: From the supermarket, head west until you reach the junction.
Go straight until you reach the corner of Hope Street and Quick Street.
Go straight until you see the restaurant on your right.
From the restaurant, head west on Quick Street and turn left at the junction.
Head south until you reach the park.
